items.out: The exit is closed by an authority on the one condition that nobody is told, since telling would be the cue to leave, and so it is closed in the hours when leaving is not possible anyway. Greek banks did not open on Monday 29 June 2015; there had been a speech on Sunday. Cyprus declared a bank holiday in March 2013 and, when parliament declined the first levy, declared it longer, until the bail-in had become law and the holiday could end. Argentina announced the corralito on a Saturday in December 2001, a day banks are not open. Export licences are suspended and listings removed and the notice is published afterwards, which is the usual place for it. What is lost is a permission: leave to move what is yours. What runs the clock is the authority's calendar, arranged to coincide with the hours the holder is locked out, Friday night and the bank holiday. The last thing that could have kept it was a transfer made on a rumour, which costs being wrong and costs the discount the rumour market charges; the deposits that left Greece that spring left on nothing firmer. This is the one expiry on the map whose notice cannot arrive before it does. A holder waiting for a date is waiting for something the mechanism does not issue. It supplies, to runway-illusions' Cash behind glass, which counts the deposit taken into receivership on a Friday as owned and out of reach, the reason it was a Friday. It is not investor-tells' Let it lapse, which the founder can test by letting it pass, since a closure that can be tested is not one that has to be a surprise; and it is not a withdrawn offer or a rival's foreclosure, which someone at the holder's own table decides, since a decree is an authority's rule on a class and nobody at the holder's table was consulted about the holder. The item stands on that fence and on no claim that the exit dies as a side effect. The decree names the exit.
items.back: Weekend closure: the option is shut by an authority whose closure works only unannounced, since announcement would be the signal to exercise, so it is shut in the hours the holder cannot act, as the Greek banks that stayed closed on Monday 29 June 2015 after a Sunday address, the Cypriot bank holiday of March 2013 extended, after parliament refused the first levy, until the bail-in was law, the Argentine corralito announced on a Saturday in December 2001, the export-licence suspension or delisting published after the fact; the condition lost is a permission, the leave to move what is yours; the carrier is the authority's calendar aligned to the hours the holder is shut out, Friday night and the bank holiday; the last intervention that could have kept it is a transfer on rumour, at the price of being wrong and of the rumour market's discount, since the deposits that left Greece that spring left on nothing better; the one expiry on the map whose notice cannot precede it, so a holder waiting for a date waits for what the mechanism forbids; adds to runway-illusions' Cash behind glass, which counts the deposit taken into receivership on a Friday as owned and unreachable, the mechanism that chose the Friday; not investor-tells' Let it lapse, which the founder can test by letting it pass, since a closure that can be probed need not be a surprise, and not a withdrawn offer or a rival's foreclosure, decided by a party at the holder's table, since the decree is an authority's rule on a class and nobody at the holder's table decided about the holder; in on that fence and not on any claim that the exit dies as a side effect, since the decree forbids the exit by name.

items.out: The claim expires on a date set in a proceeding the holder is not at, on the theory that the holder has read about it. The bankruptcy court sets a bar date for proofs of claim and informs the creditors it cannot name by putting a notice in a newspaper. The class settlement's opt-out date comes on a postcard designed, as far as anyone can tell, to look like advertising. The probate creditor's window opens when the notice runs in the county paper and closes some weeks later, the county paper having been read by the usual number of people. What is lost is a permission: standing to be paid, or to sue on one's own. What runs the clock is the bar-date order plus the rule of constructive notice, under which publication is knowledge for anyone the debtor could not name. The last thing that could have kept it is a one-page proof of claim or a signed opt-out, the cheapest filing in the law and the one least often made, the person who would make it being, by construction, the person who was not told. It supplies, to runway-illusions' Stamp's clock, where the permission's date is printed on the stamp for the holder to read, the date that is written on someone else's docket and credited to the holder anyway. It is not deal-deaths' Missing witness; nothing is missing from the record. The holder is missing from the room, which is a different thing, and the record is complete.
items.back: Bar date in the newspaper: the claim expires on a date fixed in a proceeding the holder does not attend and is deemed to have read, as the bankruptcy court's bar date for proofs of claim noticed to unknown creditors by publication, the class settlement's opt-out date on a postcard that looks like advertising, the probate creditor's window after the notice runs in the county paper; the condition lost is a permission, the standing to be paid or to sue on one's own; the carrier is the bar-date order together with the rule of constructive notice, under which publication counts as knowledge for anyone the debtor could not name; the last intervention that could have kept it is a one-page proof of claim or a signed opt-out, the cheapest filing in the law and the one least often made, since the holder who would make it is by construction the one who was not told; adds to runway-illusions' Stamp's clock, a permission with a date the holder can read on the stamp, the date written on someone else's docket and imputed to the holder; not deal-deaths' Missing witness, since nothing is missing from the record, only the holder from the room.

items.out: The option was issued under a parent instrument that has a term of its own, so it ends when the parent ends, on its merits or not, and there is no date on it, the date being on a different piece of paper. The emergency-use authorization ends when the declaration it was issued under is terminated, which is a different paper from the public-health emergency; that one ended in May 2023 and the authorizations stayed up, to the surprise of people who had assumed they were the same paper. The cross-state telehealth licence lapsed with each state's emergency in 2021 and 2022, state by state. The wartime power, the pilot run under a waiver, the sub-lease that ends with the head lease: the same. What is lost is a permission. What runs the clock is the parent's date, which the holder never signed and may never have read, the grant it did read having no date on it; step one is finding out which parent paper has the date. The last thing that could have kept it is conversion, a full approval, a permanent rule, a licence in the holder's own name, filed while the parent still stands. Conversion is slow enough that it must begin while the emergency looks like it will go on forever, which is the period in which nobody begins it. It is not Bar date in the newspaper, where the date sits on a docket and is imputed to the holder; here the date is on a different paper from the option and is entirely honest about itself. It is not lead-time-floors' Calendar with nothing in it, a wait the rule imposes; this rule does not make anyone wait. It ends.
items.back: Emergency over: the option was granted under a parent instrument with a term of its own, so it expires when the parent does, whatever its own merits and with no date printed on it, as the emergency-use authorization that ends when the declaration it was issued under is terminated, a different paper from the public-health emergency that ended in May 2023 and left the authorizations standing, the cross-state telehealth licence that lapsed with each state's emergency in 2021 and 2022, the wartime power, the pilot programme run under a waiver, the sub-lease that dies with the head lease; the condition lost is a permission; the carrier is the parent instrument's date, which the holder never signed and may never have read, since the grant it read carried no date, so the holder must first find which parent paper carries it; the last intervention that could have kept it is conversion, a full approval, a permanent rule, a licence in one's own name, filed while the parent still stands, and conversion is slow enough that it must be started while the emergency looks endless, which is exactly when nobody starts it; not Bar date in the newspaper, where the date is on a docket and imputed, since here the date is on a different paper than the option and is honest, and not lead-time-floors' Calendar with nothing in it, a wait the rule imposes, since here the rule does not wait but ends.

items.out: The option expires on the holder's own developmental schedule, which the holder cannot read, so the last intervention is by arrangement in somebody else's hand. Amblyopia is most correctable by patching the good eye in the first years; after about seven it responds less, and less completely, though the trials of the 2000s found response into the early teens, so the number seven is approximate and the eye has not read the trials either. The clubfoot is cast in infancy. The second language is spoken without an accent if learned early, a window that is disputed, the disputants having learned theirs early. The duckling imprints on its first day on whatever is there. What is lost is a capability: the cortex's willingness to rewire. What runs the clock is the developmental timetable, and the holder is a child who has not been informed that there is an eye to save. The last thing that could have kept it is a screening, the preschool vision check, the parent who notices a squint; so the option belongs to one person and its preservation to another, which is the arrangement. Where there is no screening programme, the option expires unseen at a rate that is a property of the programme and not of the child, and the programme is not examined for it. It supplies, to Last known well, where a witness dates the option, the case where the holder cannot be its own witness at all, being a child. It is not a use-it-or-lose-it; nothing the child does or fails to do runs the clock. The child is not involved.

items.out: The option is dated by the last person who saw the fact, not by the fact, so it expires when the proof runs out, the body being available for comment but not consulted. The stroke patient wakes with the deficit and is not eligible for thrombolysis, because the four-and-a-half-hour window is counted from when she was last seen well, which was bedtime, and bedtime was some hours ago; the artery may have closed at six, but nobody was there at six, so it closed at bedtime. The same rule dates the opened vial with no time on the label and the sample with a gap in its chain of custody: they expired at the earliest moment they could have, on the grounds that nobody can say they did not. What is lost is a capability: a treatment the protocol now declines to give. What runs the clock is the protocol's timestamp rule, which asks for a witness and does not ask the tissue. The last thing that could have kept it is a witness, someone awake, a time written on the vial, or a witness of another kind, the imaging that reads the tissue's own clock, by which the WAKE-UP trial of 2018 gave the drug back to patients nobody had watched. It supplies, to witness-architectures, which asks what must exist for a trace to form, the option that dies for lack of a trace while the fact would still permit it. It is not Patch before seven, where the body's own clock has run; here the body's clock may not have run at all. The record's has, and the record is what is asked.
items.back: Last known well: the option is dated by the last witness to the fact rather than by the fact, so it expires when the proof runs out while the body might still allow it, as the stroke patient who wakes with the deficit and is ineligible for thrombolysis because the four-and-a-half-hour window is counted from when she was last seen well, which was bedtime, so the wake-up stroke lost the drug regardless of when the artery closed; the same rule dates the opened vial with no time written on the label and the sample whose chain of custody has a gap, which are treated as expired at the earliest time they could have been; the condition lost is a capability, a treatment the protocol now forbids; the carrier is the protocol's timestamp rule, which asks for a witness and not for the tissue; the last intervention that could have kept it is a witness, someone awake, a time written on the vial, or a witness of a different kind, the imaging that reads the tissue's own clock, by which the WAKE-UP trial of 2018 returned the drug to patients with no witnessed onset; adds to witness-architectures, which asks what must exist for a trace to form, the option that dies for want of a trace while the fact would still allow it; not Patch before seven, where the body's own clock has run, since here the body's clock may not have run and the record's has.

items.out: The option to a decision expires because the situation finishes before the forum that would decide it gets there, so nobody declines and nobody rules and the file is closed as complete. The student who challenged a law school's admissions had his case dismissed as moot because he was about to graduate (DeFunis, 1974), the court having taken long enough for him to finish the degree it was deciding whether he could start. The pregnancy is over before the appeal. The election is held before the ballot-access case. The tenant is evicted before the housing court sits. The employee's grievance is mooted by the reorganization that abolished the post, which settles the grievance in a way. What is lost is a permission: the justiciability of the claim. What runs the clock is the ratio of the forum's pace to the harm's duration, a number no one at the table sets and the forum does not publish. The last thing that could have kept it is a structure that lasts longer than the individual harm: the class certified before the named plaintiff's harm ends, which Sosna (1975) allowed, or the doctrine that a harm capable of repetition yet evading review may be decided anyway, which Roe rested on. So the option is kept by a coordination or by a rule and never by hurrying, hurrying having been tried. It is not deal-deaths' Cost of the last mile, where the surplus is eaten on a curve; nothing here is eaten. The harm is simply over. It is not Bar date in the newspaper; there is no date anywhere, which is part of the arrangement.
items.back: Mooted: the option to a decision expires because the situation resolves itself faster than the forum that would decide it moves, so nobody declines and nobody rules, as the student whose challenge to a law school's admissions was dismissed as moot because he was about to graduate (DeFunis, 1974), the pregnancy over before the appeal, the election held before the ballot-access case, the tenant evicted before the housing court sits, the employee whose grievance is mooted by the reorganization that abolished the post; the condition lost is a permission, the justiciability of the claim; the carrier is the ratio of the forum's pace to the harm's duration, a number no party at the table sets; the last intervention that could have kept it is a structure that outlives the individual harm, the class certified before the named plaintiff's harm ends, which Sosna (1975) allowed, or the doctrine that a harm capable of repetition yet evading review may be decided anyway, which Roe rested on, so the option is kept by a coordination or by a rule and never by hurrying; not deal-deaths' Cost of the last mile, where the surplus is eaten on a curve, since here nothing is eaten and the harm is simply over, and not Bar date in the newspaper, since there is no date anywhere.

items.out: The body that could have said yes reaches the end of its own term with the matter still pending, and its successor is never asked to say no, the matter having been filed under things that were not decided. Bills die on adjournment sine die and are reintroduced from the beginning by the members who are still there. The treaty is signed and waits for a parliament that is dissolved. The permit application waits on a council that is re-elected. The old board agreed the approval in the hallway and had not yet minuted it when the board was reconstituted at the meeting, so it was agreed by a body that no longer exists. The offer was approved by a committee that the reorganization disbanded. What expires is the matter's place in the process; the successor starts it at zero, that being where the successor starts things. What is lost is a counterparty, the specific body whose yes was available. What runs the clock is the ratifier's own calendar, election, session, or term. The last thing that could have kept it is the vote scheduled before adjournment, the carry-over motion, the approval minuted instead of agreed in the hallway. The treaty cases are simplified, most unratified treaties having eventually been refused by someone; the clean form is the legislative bill, which dies by the thousand each session with no recorded no, and this is regarded as the normal end of a session. It supplies, to deal-deaths' Ratifier's other deal, where the ratifier wanted a different bargain, the ratifier that wanted this one and was gone before the vote. It is not Landlord changes, where the counterparty is replaced by transfer; here it is replaced by the calendar.
items.back: Session ends: the body that could have said yes reaches the end of its own term with the matter pending, and its successor never has to say no, as the bills that die on adjournment sine die and must be reintroduced from the beginning, the treaty signed and awaiting a parliament that is dissolved, the permit application before a council that is re-elected, the approval the old board agreed in the hallway and had not yet minuted when the board was reconstituted at the meeting, the offer approved by a committee disbanded in the reorganization; what expires is the matter's place in the process, since the successor body starts it at zero; the condition lost is a counterparty, the specific body whose yes was available; the carrier is the ratifier's own calendar, election, session, or term; the last intervention that could have kept it is the vote scheduled before adjournment, the carry-over motion, the approval minuted rather than agreed in the hallway; the treaty cases are simplified, since most unratified treaties were eventually refused by someone, and the clean form is the legislative bill, which dies by the thousand each session with no recorded no; adds to deal-deaths' Ratifier's other deal, where the ratifier wanted a different bargain, the ratifier that wanted this one and was gone before the vote; not Landlord changes, where the counterparty is replaced by transfer, since here it is replaced by the calendar.

items.out: An option held in a person rather than on the paper that transfers expires at the counterparty's next transfer, which the holder does not control and generally hears about afterwards. The landlord promises a renewal and sells the building to a buyer who is not bound by unrecorded promises and was not told of this one. The manager says 'we'll take you back' and leaves. The side letter with a fund's partner is unknown to the fund's successor manager, who has looked. The supplier's verbal priority departs with the account executive. What is lost is a counterparty, the one whose word held the option. What runs the clock is the register, the deed, the fund agreement, the offer letter on letterhead, on none of which the option was written, so the successor takes free of it, as successors do. The last thing that could have kept it is recording: a memorandum of option on the title, a side letter countersigned by the entity, the promise put on the paper that binds successors. This costs the awkwardness of asking a friendly counterparty to bind their unknown replacement, which is a real cost and is paid by almost nobody. It supplies, to term-sheet-powers' Successor in the chair, where the replacement exercises a term the friend would not have, the mirror case: the replacement declines to honour a term the friend gave. It is not Chair grown over, where the counterparty stays and the shape goes; here the counterparty goes.
items.back: Landlord changes: an option held in a person rather than on the paper that transfers expires at the counterparty's next transfer, which the holder does not control and often does not see, as the renewal promised by the landlord who sells the building to a buyer not bound by unrecorded promises, the 'we'll take you back' from a manager who leaves, the side letter with a fund's partner that the fund's successor manager has never seen, the supplier's verbal priority that vanishes with the account executive; the condition lost is a counterparty, the one whose word held the option; the carrier is the register, the deed, the fund agreement, the offer letter on letterhead, on which the option was never written, so the successor takes free of it; the last intervention that could have kept it is recording, a memorandum of option on the title, a side letter countersigned by the entity, the promise put on the paper that binds successors, which costs the awkwardness of asking a friendly counterparty to bind their unknown replacement; adds to term-sheet-powers' Successor in the chair, where the replacement exercises a term the friend would not have, the mirror case, where the replacement declines to honour a term the friend gave; not Chair grown over, where the counterparty stays and the shape goes.

items.out: The option to return rests on a vacancy the counterparty has not yet re-planned, so it expires at the counterparty's next planning cycle, with no one declining the return and no one noticing that a return was in question. The leave with no return date has its post redistributed among three people at the next reorganization, each of whom now does a third of it and would be surprised to give it back. The budget line is reallocated at year end. The supplier's line is retooled for the customer who stayed. The co-founder's seat is left empty until the next hire, at which point it is a seat. What expires is the return to the seat; employment there afterwards is a new negotiation, conducted from outside. What is lost is a capability on the counterparty's side, the shape that could receive the holder. What runs the clock is the counterparty's planning cadence, quarterly, annual, the next reorganization, which sets the expiry without any reference to the holder, the holder not being on the agenda. The last thing that could have kept it is a dated return, a leave rather than a resignation, a reservation the cycle has to respect, or the return itself before the cycle turns. It supplies, to traces-of-the-unlived's Vacancy tenant, where preparation for a future breeds its opponents, the case in which nobody opposes the return; the absence is simply absorbed, the way a building absorbs a closed door. It is not forms-of-return's Reentry burn, a road open and hostile one way. This road has closed, and nobody closed it.

items.out: An option that needs many yeses at once expires unless the gathering outruns the decay of each yes, so a coordination has a half-life and is measured in it. The recall petition's signatures older than sixty days are invalid under Michigan's rule, or must all fall within California's hundred and sixty days, so the first signer's yes is going off while the last is being collected, and the circulator is racing the first page. The tender offer's minimum condition must be met by the offer's expiry. The crowd in the square goes home, individually, for reasons. The reunion becomes impossible one death at a time, on no particular date. What is lost is a coordination. What runs the clock is the validity window on each act of assent, written by the rule or by the assenter's own attention, whichever is shorter. The last thing that could have kept it is a gathering rate, paid circulators, a date agreed in advance, a pact that binds the early yeses until the last one arrives. The recall and tender cases are observed; the crowd is analogy. It supplies, to who-can-be-bound's Place in line, an ordering lost by leaving, the coordination lost by other people's leaving. It is not Session ends, where one body's calendar kills the matter; here many small calendars do, none of them large enough to be blamed.

items.out: The holder's own growth moves the counterparty out of reach, so the option to sell to the natural acquirer expires at the round that prices the company above what the acquirer can pay at all: a market capitalization smaller than the price, a wage cap, a fund's concentration limit, and past those a board's approval ceiling, with nobody at either table declining and both tables congratulating the holder. The company's preference stack now exceeds the largest deal any of its three strategic buyers has ever done. The player's wage has outgrown every club in the league but two. The practice is too large for any partner to buy in and too small to be listed, and is therefore the right size for nothing. What is lost is a counterparty, the buyer whose capacity was the option. What runs the clock is the acquirer's capacity, readable in its market value and its deal history, set against the holder's own price, which each round raises, to applause. The last thing that could have kept it is the sale at the last price under the ceiling, which was never identified as the last, or a round sized to stay under it, which is the one choice a founder is never advised to make, and is not. The item is analytical: every observed case can be read as a buyer that would have paid more, so it stands as a mechanism and not a count. It supplies, to market-deaths' Slowed past the rot, where a market thins from the outside, the market for the holder that the holder thins by growing. It is not Chair grown over, where the counterparty re-plans; here the counterparty is unchanged and the holder has walked out of its range.

items.out: A permission is about to be withdrawn by a third party's rule change, and it can be kept only by an act in the world, no paper being accepted in lieu. The building may proceed under the old zoning only if the developer substantially began, in reliance on a valid permit, before the ordinance passed; so the footings are poured the week of the council vote, and the concrete truck is, in the strict sense, the filing. The nonconforming use survives the new code only if it is in use on the effective date. The grandfathered rate is kept only by the account that was open. What is lost is a permission. What runs the clock is the code and the vested-rights doctrine, which in most states vests on construction begun and in a few, as in Washington, on a complete application, so the last act differs by jurisdiction and the holder who knows which has a different week from the holder who does not. The last thing that could have kept it is the hole in the ground before the vote, an exercise begun rather than a filing made; the option is preserved only by starting to use it, and the hole is inspected. It supplies, to first-mover-forecloses, which holds the rival who changes the rules on purpose, the rule that changes for reasons of its own, with no rival attached. It is not Slot flown empty, where the exercise must be repeated to keep the right; here one beginning vests it for good, and the hole can then stay a hole.

items.out: The permission expires by disuse and is kept only by exercise, so the clock runs while the holder does nothing and stops when the holder acts, and the act that keeps it is the exercise with the purpose removed. The airport slot must be flown eighty percent of the season or returned, so in early 2020 airlines flew empty aircraft between cities until the rule was waived, the aircraft arriving on time. The water right under prior appropriation is forfeited after five years without beneficial use, so fields are irrigated in a drought to keep them, the water being applied to the field for the benefit of the right. The trade mark is abandoned after three years' non-use. The mining claim is kept by annual labour. The department budget is spent in the last quarter so that it is not cut, and is spent. What is lost is a permission. What runs the clock is the regulator's usage ledger. The last thing that could have kept it is the empty flight, which costs the full price of using the option and returns nothing except the option, so that keeping and using are the same act and the option's upkeep is its exercise price, paid in fuel. It supplies, to runway-illusions' Stamp's clock, whose licence lapses without hours logged and whose clock no cash extends, the price at which it can be extended after all: hours flown for nobody. It supplies, to tollgates-that-must-buy's Stamp with an expiry, where the gate must spend its stamp, the permission-holder who must burn the permission to keep it; and to power-trades' Leased strike, where disuse makes a power unbelieved, the disuse that forfeits it by rule. It is not Pour the foundation, one act that vests; here no act ever finishes the keeping, and the next season starts at zero.

items.out: The option to reverse a move expires at the first act the new state performs that the old state cannot read, so the window is the pause between the change and its first consequence, and it closes with nobody deciding to close it, the new state having simply gone to work. The merger is reversible until the first combined payroll, which is on the usual day. The new address is reversible until the first piece of mail arrives there. The reorganization is reversible until the first hire is made into the new chart. The currency changeover is reversible until the first contract is written in the new unit, which was the purpose of the changeover. What is lost is a capability, the old state's ability to take over from here. What runs the clock is the first write, performed by the new state in the ordinary course of business and not a decision about the reversal at all, nobody having been asked. The last thing that could have kept it is the expand-and-contract shape, writing to both for a season so that the old can still read, at the price of running two and of a season in which neither one is the truth, which is tolerated. It supplies, to pivot-invariants, which name the retained assets that make leaving cheap, the moment at which one of them is lost; and to undo-costs, which bills a reversal that is still possible, the reversal that stops being possible and is therefore not billed. It is not Thawed to be ready, where readiness spoils the good; here the new state's use closes the way back to the old, and the good is fine.

items.out: A pause taken to keep an option open is written on a paper with a date, so a situation that had no deadline now has one, and the paper's renewal belongs to the counterparty, who has been told, by the paper, what the pause is worth to the holder. The tolling agreement stops the limitations clock the holder could have stopped alone by filing, and expires in twelve months unless the adversary signs again, the adversary being the party it is an agreement with. The negotiated leave of absence dates a job that had no date and is extended only if the employer signs. The forbearance agreement holds the lender's foreclosure for ninety days, the lender counting. The furlough's recall rights run six months. The standstill in a takeover keeps the bidder from buying shares and ends on the day it says it ends. What is lost is a permission, the leave to remain in the paused state. What runs the clock is the pause's own instrument, and its clock is the only clock in the situation that the holder wrote, which the holder did voluntarily. The last thing that could have kept it is the renewal asked for before the counterparty learns it is needed, or a pause written without a term, which is rarely granted; the Korean armistice is the exception, has no renewal date, and is still called temporary. The statutory pauses, the twelve weeks of the family-leave statute and the restraining order's fourteen days, are the same date without the mechanism: the term is a rule's and the renewal belongs to a court or to no one, so the holder gets the deadline without paying the counterparty for it, and those are runway-illusions' Stamp's clock. It supplies, to impasse-inventions' cooling-off right, reversibility offered as a chip, the bill the chip carries. It is not lead-time-floors' No-shop, which serializes the search; here the search is stopped, and the stopping is the thing that expires.
